description: [Personal research only] Fetch Simple Moving Average (SMA) technical indicator time series with customizable time periods.

end_date.description: Optional end date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2024-12-31').

max_data_points.description: Maximum number of time series data points to return.

series_type.description: Price data to use for calculation.

start_date.description: Optional start date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2024-01-01').

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., 'AAPL', 'MSFT', 'TSLA') for which to calculate Simple Moving Average

time_period.description: Number of data points to use for moving average calculation (e.g., 20 for 20-day SMA)

name: fetch_sma
